title: Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10 - Rockstar Games
summary: The arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S consoles is now only a few weeks away. There's still time to pre-order and ensure you're able to experience Grand Theft Auto VI when it launches on November 19.
text: Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10 - Rockstar Games
